settings_display_language_description: Language for the app interface. Speech transcription uses a separate setting below.
graph_delete_entity_description: It will be removed from the graph and canonical store permanently. This cannot be undone.
graph_delete_capture_description: It will be removed from search and the graph permanently. This cannot be undone.
graph_working_description: Running the same ingest steps as on Capture.
graph_status_capture_relinked: Capture relinked to graph — layout refreshed.
graph_status_entity_sync_refreshed: Entity synced to graph — layout refreshed.
graph_drawer_community_sr: Community summary for the selected graph cluster.
graph_no_community_summary: No summary generated yet. Run the overnight heartbeat to build community summaries.
graph_drawer_node_sr: Details and edits for the selected graph or embedding-map node.
graph_rearrange_entity_hint: Rearrange writes the saved row for this node back to the graph store so layout and edges stay consistent.
graph_no_linked_captures: No linked captures for this entity yet.
graph_search_placeholder: Filter by label, id, or subtype…
graph_embedding_umap_hint: UMAP is computing a 3D layout from your embedding vectors in the browser.
graph_embedding_empty_hint: Capture some thoughts — embeddings are computed during ingest.
graph_embedding_aria: Embedding map — 3D UMAP projection of your thoughts and entities
graph_embedding_controls: Pinch or scroll to zoom · click a dot to inspect
graph_temporal_empty_hint: Tell the company brain in the Ask bar about a date, deadline or plan — it shows up here once it has been read.
graph_tasks_empty_hint: Add one above, or tell the company brain in the Ask bar — it files it. Tasks you or the agent add show up here.
graph_temporal_no_open: No open events match this filter.
graph_temporal_no_open_hint: Switch to “Show completed” to see finished items, or adjust the date filter.
graph_temporal_delete_body: “{summary}” and the thought it came from are removed from your Memory — its text, dates, projects and graph links. This can’t be undone.
graph_temporal_instruction_placeholder: Tell the assistant… move to tomorrow, snooze, reschedule
graph_timeline_focus_empty: Nothing scheduled for focus today — tell the company brain in the Ask bar what’s due.
graph_timeline_todo_all_overdue: Nothing else for today — {count} overdue, see the Overdue tab.
graph_timeline_assign_project_linked_hub: Linked to “{name}”. It will appear in Projects once another task links to the same work.
graph_timeline_assign_project_drag_hint: Drag here, then drop on a project
graph_timeline_assign_agent_empty: No connected agents yet. Register one in Settings → Connected agents.
graph_timeline_open_loop_no_delete: Tasks live in your thoughts — edit or delete the source thought instead.
graph_timeline_overdue_empty: No overdue tasks — you're on track.
graph_timeline_projects_empty: No projects yet — add one with the button above, or tell the company brain in the Ask bar what you’re working towards.
graph_timeline_create_project_descriptio: Declare a body of work so future captures can route tasks to it.
graph_timeline_project_review_hint: Reviews your existing tasks and linked thoughts — suggests what to mark done, archive, reorder, deadline, and what to do next. You confirm before anything changes.
graph_timeline_project_review_empty: No changes suggested — this project looks tidy.
graph_timeline_project_empty_tasks: No tasks in this project yet.
graph_timeline_edit_project_description: Rename this body of work so future captures can still route tasks to it.
graph_timeline_project_no_next_action: No next action defined — tell the company brain in the Ask bar what to do next for this project.
graph_timeline_project_no_project_hint: Tasks that are not in a project yet. Use Assign to put one in a project.
graph_timeline_delete_project_descriptio: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}"? It will no longer appear in your active projects.
graph_timeline_push_kind_excluded: Not enabled for this event kind in Settings
chat_briefing_hint: Your assistant will summarize today's agenda, priorities, and open loops.
notes_empty_hint: Write one here, or tell the company brain in the Ask bar and it keeps it as a document.
notes_no_linked_thoughts: Not linked to any thoughts yet.
notes_create_description: A text kept as you write it. The brain reads it, but doesn’t rewrite it.
notes_edit_description: Update the title or body. Changes are saved to your documents.
llm_entity_extraction_system: You extract structured entity mentions. entityType must always be an exact key from the entity type list in the user message, never a free-form category.
llm_entity_triple_system: You extract typed edges between known entity surfaces.
llm_gtd_assignment_system: You assign personal notes to GTD projects. projectEntityId must be copied exactly from the catalog or null. Return only valid JSON.
llm_gtd_judge_system: You judge whether a knowledge-graph hub is a personal GTD project (multi-step initiative). Return only valid JSON.
llm_project_detection_system: You extract project names from personal notes. Return only valid JSON.
llm_project_order_system: You order open project tasks into a coherent waterfall. orderedThoughtIds must use only catalog uuids, each once. Return only valid JSON.
llm_project_timeline_system: You infer a project deadline and project-scoped milestones from linked thoughts. linkedThoughtId must be from the catalog or null. Return only valid JSON.
llm_project_review_system: You review an existing GTD project and propose confirmable tidy-up changes. thoughtId and order entries must use only catalog uuids. Suggest new tasks only for real gaps. Return only valid JSON.
llm_temporal_extraction_system: You extract dates, deadlines, and temporal mentions from personal notes.
llm_cue_generation_system: You generate search cues for personal memory notes.
memory_private_note_on_hint: Only you can read it — no admin, not even the owner.
memory_private_note_off_hint: Everyone in the company can read it. Only you change it.
memory_private_project_on_hint: Only you see it and its tasks — no admin, not even the owner.
memory_private_project_off_hint: Everyone in the company sees it, its tasks and progress. Only you change it.
memory_read_only_hint: Shared by {name}. Only they change it.
memory_team_projects_empty: No colleague shares a project yet.
wish_trigger_label: Make a wish: propose an improvement
wish_page_info: Ideas, bugs and polish wishes from everyone at {company}. Make one with Make a wish at the top right and vote for the ones you want most; an agent picks them up from here.
wish_composer_hint: An idea, a bug, something that feels rough — everyone in the company can see and vote on it.
wish_composer_shared_note: Wishes are also shared with the eigenEnterprise makers, without names, unless the owner turned this off in Settings → Company.
wish_composer_placeholder: What would make this app better for you?
wish_composer_attempted: Checking, sharing or voting on a wish from Make a wish
wish_done_reading: Sounds like {kind} in {area}. An agent picks wishes up from the board; you’ll see it move to In progress and Shipped there.
wish_board_empty_requested: No wishes yet. Use Make a wish at the top right to propose an improvement.
wish_board_empty_shipped: Nothing shipped from the board yet.
wish_board_attempted: Voting on, updating, or withdrawing a wish on the Make a wish board
coworkers_page_intro: AI colleagues with their own seat: a role, accountabilities, a lens and a model. They work in Messages, like everyone.
coworkers_empty: No AI co-workers yet. Create one from a template below.
coworkers_lens_hint: What this seat cares about and pushes back on. It argues from this, not to agree.
coworkers_daily_cap_hint: What it may spend on AI per day (UTC). Then it stops and asks the person it answers to.
coworkers_create_hint: Creating asks for approval; your click is it.
coworkers_created: Created. It is on and in the org chart.
coworkers_waiting_for_approval: Waiting for approval: an owner or admin decides it in Needs you.
coworkers_remove_hint: Removing switches it off for good and takes it out of the members and the org chart. Everything it wrote stays; whoever reported to it reports to its manager.
coworkers_accountable_hint: The nearest person up the chain (else the owner): approvals it needs go to them.
coworkers_message_failed: The conversation could not be opened.
org_page_intro_admin: Who reports to whom, people and AI co-workers alike. You can edit every seat.
org_page_intro_member: Who reports to whom, people and AI co-workers alike. You can edit your own title and accountabilities.
org_empty: No one is in the org chart yet.
memory_team_notes_empty: No colleague shares a document yet.
memory_tab_documents_line: Kept as you wrote it. The brain reads it, but doesn’t rewrite it.
memory_tab_reminders_line: Comes back on the weekdays you pick, until you stop it.
memory_tab_knows_line: Everything the brain took in, and whether it’s indexed yet.
memory_tab_questions_line: Short questions for colleagues, answered right here.
questions_ask_hint: One short question. Colleagues read it here and answer when they can — it is not a chat message.
questions_text_placeholder: How do we book travel expenses?
questions_tags_placeholder: Tags, separated by commas (e.g. hr, travel)
questions_empty_for_me: No question waits for your answer.
memory_info: Tasks, projects, documents and reminders you and the agent keep — and everything the brain took in. To add something, tell the company brain in the Ask bar.
memory_tell_brain: To add something, tell the company brain in the Ask bar — it files it.
memory_tell_brain_off: The Assistant is switched off, so there is no Ask bar to tell the brain anything. An admin switches it on in Settings › Modules.
memory_knows_empty: The brain hasn’t taken anything in yet.
memory_knows_list_label: What the brain took in, newest first
memory_knows_newest: Showing the newest {count}. Ask the brain about older ones.
memory_knows_source_ui: Typed or spoken in the app
memory_knows_source_mcp: Through the ee CLI or MCP
memory_knows_delete_body: It is removed from search and the graph for good. This can’t be undone.
memory_knows_refresh_error: Couldn’t refresh the list, so the indexing status may be out of date:
memory_intake_line: How much the brain has taken in, from where and when — as far as you can see it.
memory_intake_scope: Counts your own thoughts, your documents and the documents colleagues share. A colleague’s thoughts and private documents are theirs alone.
memory_intake_newest: The newest {count} items. Ask the brain about older ones.
memory_intake_empty: The brain hasn’t taken anything in yet.
onboarding_capture_body: Tell the company brain in the Ask bar at the top: type it or say it. It files it away and remembers it for you — nothing to sort, nothing to tag.
onboarding_capture_body_2: Next time you ask, it already knows what you knew.
coworkers_rhythms_intro: Scheduled check-ins: at these times it posts in the conversation on its own, and the person it answers to sees the result in Needs you.
coworkers_rhythm_hidden: in a conversation you're not in
coworkers_rhythm_queued: Running now: the post appears in the conversation in a moment.
coworkers_rhythm_instruction_hint: It always posts at these times. Say what the post should cover.
coworkers_rhythm_no_targets: It is in no conversation you can see. Add it to a channel first, then give it a rhythm.
coworkers_runs_intro: What it did lately, newest first: what started it, how it ended, what it cost.
coworkers_runs_empty: It has not worked on anything yet.
coworkers_pickup_intro: Messages in its channels that nobody @mentioned it in, and whether Jev judged each one its to act on. This is a trial run: nothing is acted on. Mark rows to check its judgement.
coworkers_pickup_notice: Notice new messages in its channels
coworkers_pickup_agreement: Agrees with people’s marks {agreed} of {compared} times.
coworkers_pickup_counts: Last 24 hours: {decided} judged, {cap} skipped because its daily budget was spent, {author} skipped because the author’s daily budget was spent, {failed} failed.
coworkers_run_stop_post_error: the answer could not be posted
coworkers_run_stop_unavailable: switched off, removed or the rhythm was deleted
coworkers_run_stop_not_member: no longer a member of the conversation
coworkers_run_stop_task_unavailable: the task was done or gone
coworkers_run_hidden: In a conversation you're not in
coworkers_run_hidden_task: On a task that isn't yours
coworkers_empty_modal: No AI co-workers yet. Click New co-worker to create one.
coworkers_avatar_hint: Pick an eigenEnterprise CI emblem or upload a square image (cropped to 256×256 WebP).
coworkers_reports_to_multi_hint: Select one or more managers. If none are checked, it answers to the owner.
org_reports_to_multi_hint: Select one or more managers (leave all unchecked for nobody).
material_brief_placeholder: e.g. trade fair, Hall 3, booth 12, 4–6 June
material_texts_hint: Pick a variant, then edit it as you like before you download.
material_texts_no_voice: No brand voice is active yet, so these are plain texts.
material_logo_missing: Add your company logo under Settings → Company to place it on the material.
drive_selection_none_valid: No action fits every selected item.
drive_bulk_confirm_delete_one: Delete 1 item forever? This can’t be undone.
drive_bulk_confirm_delete_many: Delete {count} items forever? This can’t be undone.
drive_bulk_attempted: Acting on several selected items in Drive; each item below says why it was refused
drive_share_many_description: Gives access to every selected item. Nobody loses access they already have.
